history.answer: Brilliant Lode, a large gold mine located 1.1 km east of Charters Towers, was operated from 1879 to 1917 and closed in 1917 without a stated reason. The Geological Survey of Queensland records it as an abandoned mine with a gold size band of 50-150 tonnes. Reported production includes 22,843 ounces of gold from the Brilliant Deeps (1908-1916) and 51,482.73 kg (approximately 1.66 Moz) of gold from the Brilliant Lode (to 1917). The mine processed 2,168,244 tonnes of ore. Ownership was held by the Brilliant Deep Levels Gold Mining Company from 1896 to 1907, followed by Citigold Corporation Limited.

survey.answer: Brilliant Lode (Geological Survey of Queensland site 38722) is recorded as an abandoned mine on the Charters Towers 1:100,000 sheet (1.1 km ese of charters towers), at -20.0796, 146.2675, located to within 20 m. The survey classes its gold as large, 50-150 t. Within 5 km it records 99 other historical workings, 99 of them with gold; other commodities nearby: silver. The record gives a size band, not production figures, and holds no owners or closure dates.

structured_record.answer: Brilliant Lode (GSQ site 38722, 1.1 km ese of charters towers) is recorded by the Geological Survey of Queensland as abandoned mine, gold size band large, 50 - 150 t. Reported production: 22,843 oz gold (1908 to 1916, Brilliant Deeps (on the Brilliant reef), per Wikipedia/Queensland Heritage Register, Charters Towers mine shafts (rev 1367481111)); 51,482.73 kg gold, about 1.66 Moz troy (converted here; the survey records 51,482.73 kg) (to 1917, Brilliant Lode, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 38722)); 2,168,244 tonnes ore (to 1917, Brilliant Lode, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 38722)). GSQ MINOCC 2017 also lists 1 dated Production row (gold: 51,482.73 kg to 1917); see production. Closure: 1917 (no reason quoted) [Brilliant Extended, unknown, per Wikipedia/Queensland Heritage Register, Charters Towers mine shafts (rev 1367481111)]; 1917 (no reason quoted) [Brilliant Lode, unknown, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 38722, row 1)]. Years worked per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 38722): 1879-1917. Ownership and tenure: Brilliant Deep Levels Gold Mining Company (1896 to 1907) per Wikipedia/Queensland Heritage Register, Charters Towers mine shafts (rev 1367481111); Citigold Corporation Limited per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Tenure, SITE_NO 38722). GSQ MINOCC 2017 lists 7 company reports for this site: CR 10953, CR 12721, CR 13258, CR 25584, CR 26969, CR 28518, CR 32042. Not found: closure reason: the indexed sources give a closure year but quote no reason.
